title: Embody exact K staging and Q broadcast for p53/p54 producers
hypothesis: A 64-bank exact K store with per-lane pending masks can turn serial canonical ingress into deterministic p53/p54 parallel producer service without synthetic query variation or repeated handshakes under stalls.

direct_comparison.primary_question: Can every canonical K byte and one real shared Q group reach all p53/p54 producer inputs with exact block ownership, ordering, last markers, and ready-valid behavior?
include: complete 128 KiB int8 K head tile
group-specific p53/p54 one-block and two-block assignment
all 4,096 canonical K input flits and 8,192 producer output beats
exclude: multiple transpose buffers and fill/drain overlap

remaining_abstractions: The 128 KiB K and 1 KiB Q arrays are inferred storage rather than SRAM macros.
One transpose buffer serializes fill and drain and is not the expected throughput frontier.
V fill and cluster command release are not composed here.
Capacity-resident and transient-HBM gather scheduling remain external.
